packed_epl.positive_replacement: Original151710 explicitly copies field/pack/ into its packed-type1 effect pathname before appending %03d_ major and effect suffix. Corresponding active Steam3130bd and NSO1ed63c instead append %03d_ major and %03d.EPL placement-ID suffix into the reused buffer without that prefix-copy producer. The old prefix object is not a Golden input and has no stable replacement literal to author. Preserve placement ID versus asset ID distinction and signed s16 major; do not invent input validation or formatting defaults.
packed_epl.source_branch_only: The loose-type1 branch still writes field/effect/; that is not this packed-prefix object. Separately normalized compact model members are type0/type2 routes, not a proof for packed type1 effect namespace.
